prompt: Students who choose to drink caffeine before studying are compared with students who choose not to; the caffeine group also tends to study later at night. Which statement best identifies the design element or flaw?

options.text: There is only a lurking variable and no confounding, because study time was measured.

options.text: This is observational and has possible confounding, because caffeine use is mixed with study time and was not randomly assigned.

options.text: Blinding would remove the confounding because students would not know their own study time.

sources.note: randomization, control, placebo, and blinding serve different roles in experimental design
